144.1.text: The plain model's P(" sorry" after "I'm") on Base in the plain frame is at least its value on Instruct in the chat frame.

144.2.text: The median full-arm shift on Base in the plain frame is at most half the median on Instruct in the chat frame.

144.3.text: The median full-arm shift on Base in the chat frame is at most half the median on Instruct in the chat frame.

144.9.text: The median full-arm shift on Instruct in the plain frame is at most half the median on Instruct in the chat frame.

144.4.text: The median full-arm shifts on SFT, DPO and Instruct, all chat, lie within 1.0 of each other.

144.5.text: Across units, the Spearman correlation of full-arm shift between SFT and Instruct is at least 0.7, and between Base in the plain frame and Instruct is under 0.4.

144.6.text: From Base chat to SFT the median full-arm shift changes by more, in absolute value, than the plain model's log-odds does.

144.7.text: On Set R, in each of SFT, DPO and Instruct, the median of full minus (prompt-only + answer-only - plain), in log-odds, has magnitude at most 0.5.

144.8.text: In every cell, the median full-arm shifts of Set F's neurons and random directions differ by at most 0.5.
